Maria Torres: FYI I updated the SLO alerting mock with suppression + notification preview: https://figma.redwood/s/xyz987. Quick questions for design review: 1) preview placement: right-side flyout vs inline collapsed preview, 2) suppression scope: per-channel vs global, 3) presets UX (pills vs dropdown), 4) accessibility + keyboard for channel multiselect. Can folks give quick feedback before EOD?

Alex Kim: Love the direction. Prefer a right-side flyout for the preview because it keeps threshold controls visible. Flyout can show compact sample + a toggle "Show live stream". Also include an "Estimated alerts" line that converts percent->absolute (e.g., "0.8% errors over 15m ≈ 5 alerts/day"), users always ask that.

Kevin Zhang: Flyout makes sense for desktop. For small screens we should use a collapsible inline preview (max-height 220px) so it doesn't push users past the save button. :iphone:

Shilpa Rao: Accessibility notes: ensure the flyout is a real dialog with focus trap. Use role and aria attributes: `<div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="preview-title">`. For the channel chips multiselect, use `role="listbox"` + each chip `role="option"` and allow removal via Backspace/Delete. Example remove button: `<button aria-label="Remove channel #oncall">×</button>`. Also add visible focus outline (not just box-shadow) for keyboard users.

Priya Nair: Copy suggestions: change "Temporarily mute" to "Silence notifications" and add helper text under the timepicker: "Only channels selected below will be silenced." For presets, I prefer pill shortcuts (Work hours, Nights, Weekends) shown inline — users discover them faster that way.

design-bot: Accessibility scan result: 3 issues found  Low contrast on helper text (#9b9b9b on white), Missing focus-visible style on chips. Full report: https://ci.redwood/a11y/AL-457

Kevin Zhang: UX nit for channel list: show an avatar + truncated channel name in the chip, and a subtle `x` that appears on hover. Make sure the chip text meets AA contrast when selected. Also when many channels are selected, show "+3 more" overflow chip.

Alex Kim: About suppression scope: default to per-SLO (less surprising) but expose a toggle to apply suppression to all related routes/services. Also show timezone info (account tz by default) and on hover show UTC window.

Maria Torres: Great feedback  plan: implement right-side flyout for desktop + collapsible inline for mobile, add estimated alerts line, switch to "Silence notifications" copy, presets as visible pills, and follow Shilpa's aria patterns. I'll update Figma and create tickets for the a11y fixes flagged by design-bot. Tagging @Shilpa and @Kevin to pair on the chips pattern. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
